---


```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- jsonlite::fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson")
nrow(raw$features)
```

```{r}
fire <- raw$features[1, ]
names(fire)
fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][1, 1, ]
```

```{r}
wildfires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties)

wildfires
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- wildfires |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, "\\bAugust\\b"))

nrow(august_fires)

fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      mean(coordinates[[1]][1, , 1], na.rm = TRUE)
    }),
    lat = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      mean(coordinates[[1]][1, , 2], na.rm = TRUE)
    })
  )
```

```{r}
largest_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    popup = paste0(
      "<strong>", incident, "</strong><br>",
      "Year: ", fire_year, "<br>",
      "Acres: ", scales::comma(gis_acres)
    ),
    geometry = sf::st_sfc(
      map(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
        sf::st_polygon(list(cbind(
          coordinates[[1]][1, , 1],
          coordinates[[1]][1, , 2]
        )))
      }),
      crs = 4326
    )
  ) |>
  select(incident, fire_year, gis_acres, popup, geometry) |>
  sf::st_as_sf()

fire_bounds <- sf::st_bbox(largest_fires)

leaflet(largest_fires) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldStreetMap) |>
  addPolygons(popup = ~popup) |>
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = fire_bounds[["xmin"]],
    lat1 = fire_bounds[["ymin"]],
    lng2 = fire_bounds[["xmax"]],
    lat2 = fire_bounds[["ymax"]]
  )
```
